'''Madel Felth's agent''' was an operative of the [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. While on an undercover assignment for [[Madel Felth]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], the agent was killed by followers of the [[Gen'Dai/Legends|Gen'Dai]] known as [[the Flame]], who strung up his body at [[Rana Mas Square]] as a trap.<ref>{{TORcite|type=general|Rebellion|Nar Shaddaa}}</ref>
